data.one_liner: Curved bottom navigation bar with a customizable center action button.
data.what_it_does: Provides a curved bottom navigation bar widget that supports body items per tab, a center action button for custom actions or views, and styling for labels and icons.
use_when: You need a bottom navigation bar featuring a central action button or notch.
You want built-in handling for switching between body views based on tab selection.
avoid_when: You require standard Material Design bottom navigation without custom curves or central action buttons.
You are implementing top navigation or side drawers instead of a bottom bar.
strengths: Includes support for a center action button with its own view and tap handling.
Allows custom styling for individual tab labels as well as global text styles.
Supports programmatically changing the active page via a GlobalKey.
weaknesses: Limited to bottom navigation bar use cases.
Requires even number of destination items if an action button is set.
